[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Perform decimal division by shifting decimals to the right.

0.12 ÷ 0.3 = 1.2 ÷ 3 = 0.4

0.015 ÷ 0.5 = 0.15 ÷ 5 = 0.03

Calculation: 0.40 − 0.03 = 0.37

**∴ The correct answer is 0.37.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Expression = (0.12 ÷ 0.3) − (0.015 ÷ 0.5)

Formula: Convert decimals to fractions where a ÷ b = (a × 10ⁿ) ÷ (b × 10ⁿ)

⇒ [(12/100) ÷ (3/10)] − [(15/1000) ÷ (5/10)]

⇒ [(12/100) × (10/3)] − [(15/1000) × (10/5)]

⇒ (4/10) − (3/100)

⇒ 0.4 − 0.03

⇒ 0.37

**∴ The correct answer is 0.37.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Always solve expressions in the order of Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Decimal Division

To divide by a decimal, move the decimal point in both the dividend and divisor to the right until the divisor is a whole number.

Subtraction of Decimals

Align the decimal points vertically and add placeholder zeros if the numbers have a different number of decimal places.
